notes.title: Discord highlight of the week(April #3)
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Stanleys and Stanlettes, welcome to our latest weekly highlight! 🐣[/h3]

This is Yudi . I'm here helping out with the community management and the news, reporting live from the discord 🤓

[h3][b]What We've Been Working On📌 [/b][/h3]
We've essentially been researching how we can improve the canvas system so that it can work reliably on bigger maps without cluttering the GPU VRAM (the memory of your graphics card!) too much. As the maps get bigger and bigger, we need bigger and bigger texture and we need to find solution to mitigate the consequences of that.

Depending on how long this takes, we might rollback to a previous version of the canvas to keep pushing some fixes and updates until we get a result satisfying enough. Our goal is to improve the quality without reducing the performances too much.

notes.title: Discord highlight of the week(April #2)
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Stanleys and Stanlettes, welcome to our latest weekly highlight! 🐣[/h3]

This is Yudi and Vak. We helped with the community and Vak is the one who makes most of the STANDBOX music!!

[h3][b]So...Another seven days of grinding away... We're sacrificing sleep to get out this Canvas system. 😴[/b][/h3]

Finally I get to say it's almost complete!! 🎊✨

For those who don’t know, the Canvas update will bring a much better way to paint on the world—real-time, procedural, and baked into the map and its meshes. It's flexible, light on performance, and opens up a lot of possibilities for player expression, brutality, and... overall simulation weirdness. 🫠

🎨 Demonstrated below, it will even support multiple colors! 🖌️

[list]
[*]Some work on the [b]SDK[/b], to make mods more conveniently!
[*][b]Branding and Artstyle[/b], for the next series of advertisement and to refresh the Steam Library visuals!
[*]Some work is done on a [b]Context menu[/b], to allow more complex interactions with the objects of the game.
[*]Some [b]UI rework[/b], for the modding that will release soon!
[*]Some [b]super secret research[/b] for future features 🤫
[*]More boring work on the canvas system... zzz..
[*]Working on some tutorials to teach everyone how to make mods!

notes.title: 1.27.3 Mini Update!

New STANDBOX versions will now include a changelog directly in the menu! Most of the stuff will be shown in there, like this:

We now have "severe brain damage", that is essentially quite similar to regular brain damage, but Stanley will never recover from it. It will happen from times to times from bullet wounds to the brain.

The effect for bullet wounds has been improved to show a fake 3D parallax effect on the inside of the bullet holes.

We're trying an experimental workaround to help players with very low-fps. It should improve stability a bit under low fps (<40fps) so that Stanley doesn't oscillate and wobble and fall on his own after a while.

notes.title: Getting ready for 1.25...
notes.content:
[h1]Since I came back from vacation, we've been working on patch 1.25, and it's getting really close to done. As a reminder, here's the list of changes that will come with this version and some gameplay![/h1]

1.25 will be tested in a private playtest this week, and then will be released soon after

First, for those who don't care about words that much, here's a nearly 10 min long gameplay of all the type of stuff you can do in 1.25, like testing the new tools and weapons, showing the new UI and behaviors but also including using the preset system to [b]remove the gravity[/b], make [b]Stanley unkillable[/b] or make him walk around a bit.

[previewyoutube=y8tuS1aCo1M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Complete rewrite of the preset system:[/b] both internals and the UI. You can access and modify any variable from the main game actors!
[*]Along this, we added the PropertyDictionnary that lets you search through all of those new variables, with descriptions, default values, minimum and maximum values, so you know what to do with it.
[*]Flashbang!
[*]Visual overhaul of the grenade, and all the bullets!
[*][b]New firearm[/b], with explosive bullets!
[*]Prototype for a [b]landmine[/b]
[*]A [b]safe toy gun[/b]!
[*]slow-motion speed change is smoother and easier to control
[*]new behaviors on headshot
[*]slap can now cause brain damage
[*]follow camera can track bullets and other objects
[*]Studio green screen map for content creators
[/list]

[h3]The new grenades:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324293/7f8e7a74faabdf5153d31f88cb87cd3f52b4c202.png[/img]

and for the ones who like to experiment with things

[h3]New preset system:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324293/f3e869adad0058e25aafc807393200af9dea1d7e.png[/img]
[h3]New Property browser:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324293/ae0d6177b0a6f2088e75091cd043302528dade65.png[/img]

[h2]Foundations for the future:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reaction submanager; to allow both the devs and the modders to create new reactions in the future.
[*]SALT submanager; which will allow to easily add status effects and visuals to the player. A first effect is already in this update, providing the blinded status if the player stares at a flashbang.
[*][b]WIM[/b] (Weapon Inventory subMenus); to allow each weapon to have specific settings instead of their icon. Those could (in the future) serve per example for rate of fire selector, strength modificator, ammo selection...
[*]bullets internal system redone (only uses real world values)
[*]new BulletSpeedRatio variable (to slow down all bullets types, so that they are slow enough to be fun to play with, or to put them to real life speed)
[/list]

[h3]The new "blinded" effect from the SALT manager:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324293/d531ded72208bd8a4f8e028c83ee1e4559b42cf9.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]potential fix for the sliding bug
[*]less grenades falling through walls
[*]posturing fixed
[*]posturing from brain damage fixed (+mood)
[*]renamed GravityScale into GravityForce (it's in cm/s, it's not a scale)
[/list]

And that's all I can think about for now! A bit of a long-winded post, but I wanted to give you some more info about the progress and what will be in the next update. 

Now, I understand some players might get a feeling that some of theses like the foundations for the future part (SALT submanager, Reaction submanager etc) might not be a priority, but please understand that this is part of making the game ready for both the workshop and also more updates from our side, more easily and quickly in the future. Stronger foundations = stronger builds!

[h2]And YES, before I get drowned in the comments, [b]WE ARE STILL ACTIVELY WORKING ON THE WORKSHOP[/b], this is part of it! The preset system will use the workshop as well, so that you can all share it easily. [/h2]

But in the meantime, [url=https://discord.com/servers/standbox-1072265695297019996]we share our presets on the official community![/url]

notes.title: Working on the next update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] - LANDMINES
[*] - PRESET SYSTEM REFORGE
[*] - A TOOL/STUDIO MAP FOR GREENSCREENS
[*] - A NEW "ADVANCED" SECTION TO CHANGE LEVELS
[*] - REWORKING THE UI
[*] - MAYBE A TUTORIAL?
[*] - MAYBE MORE
[/list]

[h2]LANDMINES:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=kA79sU-TSZQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]ADVANCED LEVEL SELECTION + NEW STUDIO MAP:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=08Lc4NN7VrM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]NEW LEVEL SELECTION:[/h3]
Both for alternate maps or variants that shouldn't be on the main page, or for modders to add their maps! Alternatively, for modders/devs or investigative players, you can run the maps directly by using the name of the map if you know it.

[h3]GREENSCREEN STUDIO:[/h3]
A new map for the creative players! I've seen some players try to do creative things, both with photoshops or video editing. That map will make it easier. You have a controllable light emitting screens, that you can use color and light properly (to better fit whatever you are going to use it for) and a greenscreen/chromakey shader, that you can use to hide the background with a color of your choosing, so that you can easily chromakey it away in your favorite editor (photoshop, video editing software etc...)

[h3]PRESET SYSTEM REFORGE:[/h3]
The entire preset system has been redone, to be more powerful and to work with anything that will be added in the game in the future, including mods! Instead of having access to a few hardcoded values, you'll now have access to ANY variables, allowing you to modify things we didn't even consider! Maybe you can do something cool we didn't plan for! Maybe you can break the game! The power should be in your hands. It's not modding yet, but it already gives you a bit more control in the sandbox rules.

It is already accessible on the public-beta branch, but it will release on the main version next update.

[h3]others:[/h3]
Beside that, I'd like to rework the UI, add a tutorial (I see a lot of people, even big streamers, miss a lot of core features of the game!), and I have a few other things planned, but we'll see how much actually gets in the next patch.

At the very least, you'll definitely get the new studio map, the level selection menu and the preset reforge. And the landmines, OF COURSE.

In the background, even if you can't see it, we're still working on the core code of the game, to make it ready for modding, and some other features we haven't mentioned publicly yet. 

Let me know what you think, I'm always happy to get feedback! [url=https://discord.com/servers/standbox-1072265695297019996]And don't forget, I post way more updates on the Discord, so feel free to join if you want to see everyday details about what I'm working on, or participate in some events that might get you free keys and other rewards!
[/url]
See ya soon!

notes.title: OMG DEAD GAME????
notes.content:
Going from feedback I get from either reviews or some comments I hear, it seems clear that not everyone knows where I'm headed with STANDBOX and what are my intents. So what is going on?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324293/7aead78f86530c5ecdea57cb0525bdb9b205e433.png[/img]

[h1]Is the game ABANDONNED?[/h1]
Nope! Not at all.

The game is being worked on and is still receiving updates and fixes. I've just released 1.02 in beta, and is going to go public soon, and I'm already working on 1.03. 

Yet, I've very clearly announced in multiple places [b]to not expect updates[/b]. 

[h1]Why?[/h1]
I'm not comfortable with the current trends of over-promising and under-delivering that we often see, both in indie games and AAA games. I have plans, I have lots of ideas. I have things I want to do, and things I want to improve. But I don't want to overshare those dreams and lead people to feel cheated if I'm not able or willing to realize them later on. 

The only thing I can promise is the game as it exist in its current form. It is a finished product. I want to be clear with what I'm selling and what the player will be receiving. That's why I'm selling this game as a finished product and not an early access. 

Past that, [b]as long as I enjoy working on it and I have a vision for the game, I'll try to keep working on it.[/b]

[h1]Sooo... More content?[/h1]
Currently, multiple things are going on for the game:
[list]
[*]I'm working on additional content
[*]More achievements are coming
[*]I might refactor some features (preset system bad, must redo!) 
[*]I'm looking for external help to improve some aspects of the game
[*]I'm actively looking to implement modding
[*]I'm looking to get animations made to replace existing ones and add new ones...
[*]I'm still working on fixes for some issues
[/list]

I've been communicating a lot about what's going-on, but I mostly did it on the discord here and since not everyone is on the discord, perhaps it led some people to believe that I didn't care for this project. This is absolutely not the case.

Let me know if this form of communication can help. In the meantime, I'll always be reachable in the Steam Discussions or Discord.

notes.title: 1.01: SMALL FIXES, SMALL FEATURES
notes.content:
Hello guys! Here it is, the first update for STBX. It's mostly made to adress a few gameplay issues reported by players.

Not everything was fixed, there's still issues regarding the brick/grenade collision issue, I'll change the entire system later down the line. 

I added/improved the brain damage state, and brought back the wound opening on impact. Looks great when you slam a brick in his face! Talking about throwing, you now have a power meter to display how hard you are going to slap/throw things. Slapping at full power is pretty fun too! 

The default keybindings are now based on Qwerty by the way! So international players will be more comfortable with the camera control schemes. This should have been done at release but it was an oversight on my end.

I hope you will enjoy this small update. :)

[h2]New Content:[/h2]
[list]
[*]a power meter for the slap/brick/grenade throwing!
[*]slapping can now be held to hit harder
[*]new dementia state (brain damage)
[*]wounds can open on high speed impact
[*][strike]...easter egg[/strike] (?)
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] brain damaged state is longer now
[*] changed the "spam any key" text at the intro to be easier to understand.
[*] removed sub-menu for throwing items, everything on main level now
[*] camera controls defaults to QWERTY (WASD)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] grenade icon fixed (not showing up)
[*] grenade/bricks not being remembered properly
[*] grenade/bricks outline fixed
[*] improved some areas where grenades and bricks fell off the map (not 100% fixed)
[*] AK/slap sound volume issue fixed 
[*] Fixed the character not leaving the animation when grabbed
[*] Fixed some walls that prevented spawning Stanley in from the outside
[*] Fixed a bug where he would blink when uncounscious
[/list]
